programs.title: Cocktail
programs.desc: Mira gets entangled in a love triangle, where she has some feelings for Guatam, who in turn is in love with their friend Veronica. So things won't get more complicated, she runs away without expressing her feelings to her love. Deepika Padukone, Saif Ali Khan, Boman Irani, Diana Penty, Mia Uyeda, Homi Adajania, Imtiaz Ali.

programs.title: Jabariya Jodi
programs.desc: A thug schemes for an abduction process in an attempt to cancel a groom's wedding, and avoid paying for the dowries. Sidharth Malhotra, Parineeti Chopra, Javed Jaffrey, Sanjay Mishra, Aparshakti Khurana, Prashant Singh, Sanjeev k Jha.

programs.title: Chandu Champion
programs.desc: Faced with seemingly insurmountable obstacles, an extraordinary young man displays unwavering determination, channeling his resilience to overcome adversity and ultimately achieve a landmark accomplishment. Kartik Aaryan, Vijay Raaz, Bhuvan Arora, Yashpal Sharma, Kabir Khan, Kabir Khan, Sumit Arora.
